
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/keguoquan/p/19192434" title="发布于 2025-11-05 09:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">影像云胶片：Dicom纯js的三维重建影像阅片器</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong>影像云胶片主要：</strong>通过浏览器浏览Dicom影像阅片，通过多终端设备（如电脑、平板、手机），为医生、患者及其他授权人员提供随时随地的影像调阅功能，打破时间和空间限制。同时，支持影像数据在不同医疗机构之间的安全共享，促进医疗协作与远程会诊的开展。主要功能：</p>
<ol>
<li>支持标准DIcom影像的2D浏览，预设窗位，伪彩，序列间，序列内多种布局方式。</li>
<li>影像处理，提供影像翻图、缩放、移动、透镜、反相、旋转、截图等操作</li>
<li>影像测量，提供箭头、直线、十字架、角度、Cobb、心胸比、椭圆、矩形、勾画，橡皮擦、CT值等数据的测量</li>
<li>支持影像的三维重建，包括多平面重建，容积漫游技术（VR）、最大/小密度投影等功能</li>
<li>支持影像胶片打印功能，包括DR，CT等胶片自定义布局打印</li>
<li>支持平板，手机等移动设备的影像浏览</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>总体架构：BS（浏览器/服务器）架构</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>前端</strong>：基于HTML5、WebGL技术开发，无需安装插件，支持PC浏览器、手机H5、微信小程序、支付宝小程序等多种终端。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>后端</strong>：后端居于fo-dicom组件进行开发，对dicom文件访问授权服务，访问MD5签名验证等身份验证。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>核心技术栈</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>影像渲染引擎</strong>：使用&nbsp;<strong>VTK.js</strong>&nbsp;等开源框架，实现基于WebGL的高性能二维、三维影像渲染。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>DICOM服务</strong>：自研或使用开源组件（如fo-dicom）实现DICOM文件的接收（C-Store）、查询（C-Find）、检索（C-Move）等服务。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>主要代码示例</strong></p>
<p><strong>1：前端采用有</strong>vue3+element-ui进行开发，检查屏幕大小，以便适应不同的屏幕</p>

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (window.innerWidth &gt; 768<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    ElMessageBox.alert(</span>"系统检测到你在阅片期间对浏览器进行了缩放。为防止图像显示及测量工作不精确，强烈建议您重新打开影像！"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">初始化一个视窗</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ViewGridChange_LoadDicom_OneView(layout, element, showSeries) {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">注册事件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  element.addEventListener(IMAGE_RENDERED, IMAGE_RENDERED_CallBack);

  layout.ShowSeries </span>= showSeries;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">当前窗体显示的序列对象</span>
  element.ShowSeries = showSeries;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">当前窗体显示的序列对象</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  let viewport;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (showSeries.SeriesItemType == 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    viewport </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      viewportId: layout.viewportId,
      type: showSeries.viewType,
      element: element
    }
    element.addEventListener(STACK_NEW_IMAGE, STACK_NEW_IMAGE_CallBack);
  } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    viewport </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      viewportId: layout.viewportId,
      type: showSeries.viewType,
      element: element,
      defaultOptions: {
        orientation: showSeries.orientation
      },
    }
    element.addEventListener(VOLUME_NEW_IMAGE, VOLUME_NEW_IMAGE_CallBack);
  }
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> viewport;
}</span></pre>

<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>4：胶片打印布局设置相关代码</strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img id="code_img_closed_dfddf9c2-c994-4c75-b362-dc29f9094862" class="code_img_closed lazyload" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif"><img id="code_img_opened_dfddf9c2-c994-4c75-b362-dc29f9094862" class="code_img_opened lazyload" style="display: none" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_dfddf9c2-c994-4c75-b362-dc29f9094862" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置中间图像大小</span>
let curGolb_PaperSize = "";<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">当前纸张大小</span>
let curGolb_Direction = "";<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">当前方向</span>
let curGolb_ShowScale = "1";<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">当前显示比例</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CenterSetImageSize(paperSize, direction, showScale, isPrint) {
    SetImageSizeisPrint </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isPrint;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (isEmpty(paperSize)) paperSize =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> curGolb_PaperSize;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (isEmpty(direction)) direction =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> curGolb_Direction;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (isEmpty(showScale)) showScale =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> curGolb_ShowScale;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (curGolb_PaperSize == paperSize &amp;&amp; curGolb_Direction == direction &amp;&amp; curGolb_ShowScale ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> showScale) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    curGolb_PaperSize </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> paperSize;
    curGolb_Direction </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> direction;
    curGolb_ShowScale </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> showScale;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">根据纸张大写设置图像大小</span>
    let paperObj = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (let i = 0; i &lt; PaperSizeArys.length; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        const item </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PaperSizeArys[i];
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (item.value ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> paperSize) {
            paperObj </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> item;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!paperObj) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置图像大小</span>
    let imgWidth = 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    let imgHeight </span>= 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (direction == "0") {<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">横向</span>
        imgWidth =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> paperObj.ImgHeight;
        imgHeight </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> paperObj.ImgWidth;
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> {<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">纵向</span>
        imgWidth =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> paperObj.ImgWidth;
        imgHeight </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> paperObj.ImgHeight;
    }
    let imgWidthPx </span>= imgWidth * 96<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    let imgHeightPx </span>= imgHeight * 96<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    let scaleFloat </span>= 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (showScale == "-2") {<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">自适应宽高</span>
        const rect =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> divImgElemet.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">如果宽或者高 任意一个大于了外层容器 则进行缩放</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (imgWidthPx &gt; rect.width || imgHeightPx &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rect.height) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">如果宽超出的范围更大，则以宽为基准进行缩放</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (imgWidthPx - rect.width &gt;= imgHeightPx -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rect.height) {
                scaleFloat </span>= rect.width /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imgWidthPx;
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">以高位基准进行缩放</span>
                scaleFloat = rect.height /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imgHeightPx;
            }
            scaleFloat </span>= scaleFloat * 0.98;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">自适应时设置图像显示比例98%,防止出现滚动条</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (showScale == "-1") {<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">自适应宽</span>
        const rect =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> divImgElemet.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">如果宽或者高 任意一个大于了外层容器 则进行缩放</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (imgWidthPx &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rect.width) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">如果宽超出的范围更大，则以宽为基准进行缩放            </span>
            scaleFloat = rect.width / imgWidthPx * 0.98;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">自适应时设置图像显示比例98%,防止出现滚动条</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        scaleFloat </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parseFloat(showScale);
    }
    imgWidth </span>= numToFixed(imgWidth * scaleFloat, 0) + "in"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    imgHeight </span>= numToFixed(imgHeight * scaleFloat, 0) + "in"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (imgWidth == divImgElemet.style.width &amp;&amp; imgHeight ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> divImgElemet.style.height) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">图像大小不变，如果是打印则直接执行打印</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (SetImageSizeisPrint == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
            PrintCurrentPage(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        divImgElemet.style.width </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imgWidth;
        divImgElemet.style.height </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imgHeight;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置图像上字体大小</span>
        let dfontSieze = 11<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">isEmpty(PrintConfigObj.FontSize)) {
            dfontSieze </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parseInt(PrintConfigObj.FontSize);
        }
        const setFontSize </span>= numToFixed(dfontSieze * scaleFloat, 2) + "px";<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">标注字体为11px，乘以缩放比例</span>
        divImgElemet.style.fontSize =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> setFontSize;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">获取元素像素大小</span>
        document.querySelector("#spShowImgSizePx").innerHTML = divImgElemet.scrollWidth + "×" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> divImgElemet.scrollHeight;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
